rows.name: min_sep
rows.decision: The physical size of a neuron, not a design choice. Its best value is "as small as possible", so a brain allowed to tune it would just drive it to zero for free speed. Keep it fixed at 0.3 (this is the speed limit assumption).

rows.name: us_per_unit
rows.decision: Fix at 40 (it only converts distance to microseconds; scaling was exactly linear).
